title: Design System: Copilot Projects - Studio Console

title.purpose: Native callout semibold in the top drag strip; semantic size remains platform-owned.

session.purpose: Native body medium in vertical session rows, wrapping to two lines without inactive-title dimming.

label.purpose: Native caption semibold for message roles.

metadata.purpose: Native caption/caption2 for session states, project context in the Sessions header, project-row metadata, footer version, and transcript timestamps. The active-session heading does not repeat the project subtitle. Project-row count/idle labels inherit native List ink; custom-chrome metadata uses secondaryText. Sizes remain semantic.

shadows.name: details-drawer
shadows.purpose: Schematic CSS equivalent of the native drawer shadow: black at 20%, radius 12pt, x -4pt; not a pixel-equivalent blur contract.

shadows.name: modifier-number
shadows.purpose: Schematic CSS equivalent of the existing native number-badge shadow.

motion.name: details-disclosure
motion.purpose: Existing trailing move plus opacity; Reduce Motion removes custom animation and uses opacity-only transition.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Existing borderless-control hover highlight; disabled with Reduce Motion.

components.name: Session browser header
components.description: Schematic Views.swift SessionBrowser header at the 224pt ideal column width and 56pt aligned height. The resident Projects toggle shares scene-owned visibility with the native View menu (Command-0); creation stays trailing. Native controls and resizing are not reimplemented.
components.html: SessionsProject name
components.css: .ds-browser-header { color-scheme:dark; width:204px; height:56px; padding:0 10px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#202327; color:CanvasText; font:menu; } .ds-browser-header button { display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; } .ds-projects-toggle { width:28px; height:28px; } .ds-browser-title { display:grid; gap:3px; min-width:0; flex:1; } .ds-browser-title strong { font-weight:600; } .ds-browser-title span { overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; color:#BAC4CE; font:caption; } .ds-session-creation { display:flex; align-items:center; border-radius:5px; transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-session-creation:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-new-session { width:24px; height:22px; } .ds-session-options { width:22px; height:22px; } .ds-creation-divider { height:14px; border-left:1px solid GrayText; } .ds-browser-header button:focus-visible { outline:auto; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-session-creation { transition:none; } }

components.name: Selected session
components.description: Schematic dark Views.swift SessionRow: two-line name, explicit Idle state, steel fill and one-point edge. Select and End are separate buttons, as in the native accessibility representation. Placeholder text and browser-native focus are not interaction certification.
components.css: .ds-selected-preview { color-scheme:dark; width:204px; padding:10px; background:#202327; color:CanvasText; font:menu; } .ds-session-selected { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:6px; background:#3C4A56; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #AAC6D9; } .ds-selected-select { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:7px; flex:1; min-width:0; padding:10px 0; border:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; text-align:left; font:inherit; } .ds-selected-slot { width:18px; height:18px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-selected-copy { display:grid; gap:5px; min-width:0; } .ds-selected-title { display:-webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; font-weight:500; } .ds-selected-state { font:caption; color:#BAC4CE; } .ds-selected-end { display:grid; place-items:center; width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:GrayText; } .ds-session-selected:hover { background:#3C4A56; } .ds-selected-select:focus-visible, .ds-selected-end:focus-visible { outline:auto; }

components.name: Inactive session
components.description: Schematic vertical SessionRow with full-strength two-line name, explicit Idle state, and raised hover. Selection and ending remain separate; the empty indicator slot represents idle without unread work.
components.css: .ds-inactive-preview { color-scheme:dark; width:204px; padding:10px; background:#202327; color:CanvasText; font:menu; } .ds-session-inactive { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; } .ds-inactive-select { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:7px; flex:1; min-width:0; padding:10px 0; border:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; text-align:left; font:inherit; } .ds-inactive-slot { width:18px; height:18px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-inactive-copy { display:grid; gap:5px; min-width:0; } .ds-inactive-title { display:-webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; font-weight:500; } .ds-inactive-state { font:caption; color:#BAC4CE; } .ds-inactive-end { display:grid; place-items:center; width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:GrayText; } .ds-session-inactive:hover { background:#30363D; } .ds-inactive-select:focus-visible, .ds-inactive-end:focus-visible { outline:auto; }

components.name: New Project
components.description: Borderless native action preview; the actual button retains its native label, symbol, control size, and action.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { color-scheme:dark; background:#25292E; } .ds-new-project { font:menu; color:CanvasText; background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:5px; padding:4px 6px; transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-new-project:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-new-project:focus-visible { outline:auto; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-new-project { transition:none; } }

components.name: Project row
components.description: Static unselected ProjectRow hierarchy: full-name tooltip and inherited List ink for the name, count, and idle. Active counts use native symbols with ViewThatFits priority fallback and complete tooltip/accessibility counts in Views.swift; native selection, fallback, menus, and drag/drop are not reimplemented here.
components.html: Project nameSession countidle
components.css: .ds-project-list { color-scheme:dark; background:#25292E; color:CanvasText; font:menu; } .ds-project-row { display:grid; gap:3px; padding:5px 0; } .ds-project-title { font-weight:500; }

components.name: User message
components.description: Schematic individual user-text surface, not an enclosing turn card. Text is a documentation placeholder.
components.css: .ds-user-message { color-scheme:dark; font:menu; color:CanvasText; padding:10px; background:#2D3943; border-radius:9px; white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }

components.name: Session details drawer
components.description: Schematic dark drawer shell, opened beside the terminal glyph in the active-session heading when details are available and closed. Native dividers, Markdown, workflow controls, and Metal terminal output are not represented.
components.css: .ds-drawer { color-scheme:dark; width:420px; background:#202327; color:CanvasText; font:menu; box-shadow:-4px 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-drawer-title { display:flex; align-items:center; height:44px; padding:0 14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-drawer-body { padding:6px 18px; color:#BAC4CE; }

narrative.overview:
A precise native workspace for parallel coding sessions. Graphite layers in dark
appearance and satin gray layers in light appearance frame the work without
competing with terminal output. Steel selection is steady and legible.

Native controls, readable system type, and compact spacing carry the character.
Details are available on demand; glow, ornamental hardware, and decorative
terminal motion are not part of the selected direction.
keyCharacteristics: Adaptive native surfaces, not a user-selectable theme.
Stable steel selection with readable inactive labels.

rules.name: The Readable Layers Rule
rules.body: Resolve all seven roles together from system appearance for custom chrome; keep their ink readable without overriding native List selection/emphasis colors on project names, session counts, or idle labels.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve system text semantics and full-strength inactive session titles; hierarchy comes from weight, spacing, and surface rather than dimming the whole row.

rules.name: The Steady Selection Rule
rules.body: Change fill and edge without scaling or moving the selected session; retain separate select, end, and drag actions.

dos: Do resolve the complete native appearance family for custom chrome, while leaving native List row ink inherited.
Do retain native labels, traffic lights, keyboard shortcuts, drag/drop, and ending safeguards.
Do keep the terminal primary and the details drawer secondary.
donts: Don't dim inactive session titles or merge high-contrast-light surface roles.
Don't add glow, ornamental hardware, or selection scaling.
Don't turn documentation tokens into a theme picker or a shared runtime dependency.
